items.text:
#TeamBarragán was out in #CA44 this weekend! 

Yesterday we joined @first5la, @providence Wilmington Wellness Ctr, & Best Start Wilmington at @lahcedu.

Great to see after 3 years of hard work the creation of a safe decorative crosswalk to help residents cross Figueroa safely! https://t.co/yPjzETLVrR

Thank you @POTUS Biden for signing an Executive Order to protect access to contraceptives, safeguard clinics and providers, and defend patient data as they exercise their right to choose.
 
Our work is not done. We MUST codify Roe to ensure abortion access is legal everywhere.

#TeamBarragán in the community last week.

At the Grand Reopening of @WLCAC Bradley Senior Center! 

The center is a vital resource for seniors, offering health & wellness programs, education workshops, & free transportation to appointments in South LA. #CA44 #Watts #WLCAC https://t.co/oHGbOcUbqS

Well, Republicans finally elected a Speaker & gaveled in the 118th Congress.

Now they’re trying to force rules that attack abortion rights & double down on the inhumane treatment of migrants.

AND a bill that protects wealthy tax cheats.

Ridiculous.

My speech: 👇🏽 https://t.co/Gv3lzMVidg

Cancer is not a one size fits all diagnosis. It is an aggressive disease that impacts millions of Americans each year - especially communities of color.

This Word Cancer Day I encourage everyone to seek preventative care and screening. #WCD2023 https://t.co/TQaXPzs8JM

Today we recognize the disproportionate impact the HIV & AIDS epidemic has on Black communities, & raise awareness of the barriers that many face in seeking treatment.
 
On #NBHAAD we work to increase awareness of HIV stigma & barriers, & improve access to treatment for all. https://t.co/WqySzVtaMU

Today @HHSgov launched https://t.co/YCIPwYf6eZ to help people navigate how to find support or treatment options for issues with mental health, drugs, or alcohol.

Tool identifies support based on insurance status & helps users book an appointment w/ a healthcare provider. More👇🏽

👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾👏🏾

Glad @ilwulongshore & @WestCoastPorts reached a tentative agreement that respects the value of our longshore workers.

I stand with our #ILWU workers to ensure they get the treatment they deserve. 

Shout out @JulieSuCA for her leadership at the negotiation table.

Inspiring visit w/the beautiful children of Tanzania, community leaders & health workers to learn about efforts to combat health & nutrition challenges.

We must continue to support efforts by  @UN, @unfoundation, @UNICEF & @FAO to address children’s malnutrition. https://t.co/ZEqtNCsD0Q

🚨ATTN #CA44 Veterans!

@DeptVetAffairs has announced an expansion of VA benefits under the PACT Act, which helps Veterans exposed to toxic substances during their service.

In addition to treatment for toxic exposure, Veterans can now qualify for breast cancer risk assessments, mammograms, and other forms of preventative care regardless of age.

Find out more about your benefits at: https://t.co/WCvZ3T6t5s

Happy Labor Day!

It’s been a summer of Labor solidarity across America - as workers fight for fair wages, worker protections, & better conditions.

Proud to stand w/ our workers for fair deals & better conditions & support their exercise of collective strength. #LaborDay https://t.co/uHFQPnFuRi

My mom and dad worked incredibly hard so their kids could have a bright future.

Threats to child healthcare, education, & nutrition mean we have to continue to fight & make children a priority. Honored to be named a @Campaign4Kids Champion for Children! https://t.co/SvWCl4uzxZ

Cancer is not a one size fits all diagnosis. It is an aggressive disease that impacts millions of Americans and their families each year – including mine. 

Unfortunately, communities of color are disproportionately impacted by late-stage diagnosis & see higher rates of mortality from cancer.
 
This #WorldCancerDay, we raise awareness & encourage the prevention, early detection, & treatment of the disease.

Most rare diseases don’t have an FDA-approved treatment & children are disproportionately represented among the rare disease patient population.

Proud to join my colleagues to reauthorize the critical Creating Hope Act & ensure children have access to innovative FDA-approved treatments.

Started a busy day at the Carole Keen Carson Wellness Center at #Carson High School. 

Great opportunity to learn more about their work on behalf of the students at Carson High & Carson residents, & their upcoming projects. 

Thank you @VeniceFamClinic for an informative visit. https://t.co/gmfN6MmSVC

There is a close connection between oral health & diabetes. Diagnosis & treatment of dental infections has proven effective in successful care for patients with diabetes.
 
Proud to join @RepCohen & @RepLloydDoggett to lead 37 colleagues on a letter to @CMSgov Administrator @BrooksLaSureCMS to support dental coverage for Medicare enrollees with diabetes.

Over 300 million people are affected by a Rare Disease worldwide. Children make up nearly half of those living with rare diseases, yet children's treatment options are extremely limited.
 
Proud to co-lead the Creating Hope Reauthorization Act, which will help with the development of new drugs for children with rare pediatric diseases.
 
On World Rare Disease Day, we raise awareness & continue our support for those affected.

When you receive healthcare, you should know EXACTLY how much it will cost BEFORE you receive treatment.
 
That's why I was proud to welcome @fatjoe to @POTUS Biden's #SOTU last night to highlight his work w/@PowertoPatnts advocating for full price transparency in healthcare. https://t.co/5qT95hgtrK

Over 650,000 people experience homelessness on any given night in the US. Many are chronically homeless and need access to mental health services & medical treatment. 
 
Proud to introduce the Housing ACCESS Act today to work to end the homelessness crises and better connect Medicaid beneficiaries to critical services that find & secure housing. 
 
Read more: https://t.co/Fp4q7SAH9W

The earlier Alzheimer's is detected, the more time patients and families have to get treatment & spend time with loved ones.

Proud to introduce the AADAPT Act w/@RepBuddyCarter, @RepPaulTonko, & @RepLaHood which will provide training on Alzheimer’s disease to primary care providers.

In #SouthGate this morning to present nearly $1 MILLION in funding I secured for clean drinking water! 

Funding will support the development of new treatment facilities to remove PFAS and other contaminants from two shuttered water wells in the city. Once remediated, the wells will provide a new supply of safe drinking water for local residents.

Thank you South Gate Mayor Hurtado and the @SouthGateCAgov for partnering with me on this critical project in #CA44.

Today is National Black HIV & AIDS Awareness Day. Thanks to investment in research and healthcare programs, we know that education, testing, prevention, and treatment save lives. 

On #NBHAAD, let’s break the stigma, encourage routine testing, and support equitable healthcare access for all.  #StopHIVTogether

Today on #RareDiseaseDay we raise awareness of the 30 million Americans and 300 million people worldwide who are living with a rare disease. Their fight is often long and challenging, marked by delays in diagnosis and limited treatment options.
 
Together, we can fight for advancements in care and support those impacted by rare diseases.
